title: The observation request
description: Asks the running sketch to be observed. The writer places this atomically by way of a temporary file, and id changes with every request (ADR-0018 decision 3). With count at 2 or more, shots are taken in succession without stopping the frame loop, and the catalogue is written last.

id.description: This request's identifier. The reply echoes it back. A request with an id already seen is not processed again.

scale.description: How far to scale the written image down (1 = full size). 1 when omitted.

count.description: How many shots to take. 1 when omitted. Asking above the ceiling is never trimmed in silence: how many were cut appears in the reply's warnings.

every.description: Take a shot every this many frames. Every frame when omitted. **Counted in frames rather than seconds** — the default clock is derived from the frame number, so counting in frames means running the same sketch twice returns the same series.
